{"title":"","type":"markdown","aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":12,"openLinksInNewTab":true,"markdown":"## Distributed workloads: the altitudes of execution
Dinis and Angelo's model of where the agentic team's work runs (briefs 14, 15 and the operating model, 11 November 2026). **The same shape at every size**: an objective, a mandate, a grant, a key pair, a signed result; only the altitude changes: **A4** swarm (agents of agents) · **A3** agent (a loop with an identity and a wake) · **A2** loop with tools · **A1** one LLM call · **A0** compute. Each placement names its runtime (**R1** Claude Code cloud ...), model endpoint (**M1** Anthropic, **M2/M3** open-weight via the router ...), I/O level (**L0** chat to **L5**) and session mode (**S0** stateless call, **S1** chat session, **S2** agent loop).

> "Try to use as much frontier models, so much open-weight models as we can ... the point here is not to slow down." (Dinis)

Sources: [where agents run](https://lisbontechfringe.com/agentic-team/where-agents-run/) · [the operating model](https://lisbontechfringe.com/agentic-team/operating-model/) · data/runtimes.json, data/operating-model.json, data/work-altitudes.json (signed), data/run-reach.json, tasks/, team/angelo/."}}

attributes.visState: {"title":"","type":"markdown","aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":12,"openLinksInNewTab":true,"markdown":"## Elastic operations: who submits what\nAny agent submits to its own index with `admin/tools/elastic-submit.mjs` (push) or commits a JSON file with an `elastic_feed` header that elastic.1 sends each hour (feed); dashboards come from a spec in the agent's own path (`admin/tools/elastic-dashboard.mjs`). The rules: **docs/elastic-guidance.md**. A **held** document failed the privacy checks (an email, a phone, a key) and was not sent; **errors** are mapping rejections. Indices are `<fringe|ptnews|websummit|swarm|agents>-<kind>`, owned by the agent that created them."}}
